_comment: Buying committee + message blocks. Vars: {company} {agent_count} {industry_lower} {roi_annual} {roi_per_agent} {trigger_detail} {stakes} {idle_benchmark} {insight_tail} {peer_outcome} {acd} {wfm} {first_name} {seller_first}. Every day-1 email carries four beats: the trigger, the stakes (why now / cost of waiting), a teaching insight with a number that challenges their assumption, and a peer outcome that mirrors them. First touch offers a one-page read (no meeting); the meeting ask is a specific diagnostic in the final touch. Benchmark and peer numbers come from proof.json and must be verified before sending.
